title: Spectate resync frame (spectator -> server, inbound, OPTIONAL)
description: Optional recovery control frame. Asks the server to re-send the current full spectator_frame (e.g. after the client detected a seq gap or lost local state). Purely opt-in; a minimal spectator never sends it because every spectator_frame is already a full snapshot. Does NOT re-subscribe or change the bound match; one match per connection (reconnect to watch another).

since_seq.description: OPTIONAL last-rendered seq; the server sends the current full frame regardless.
